text.p: EDAP TMS S.A., a French societe anonyme, filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering to sell up to four million American depositary shares.
The initial price of the ADS is estimated to be between $9 and $11 per ADS, EDAP said the filing.

Of the total offering, 2.8 million ADSs are being sold in the United States and Canada while 1.2 million ADSs are being offered outside the two countries. After the offering, the outstanding ADS will total 8,688,500 shares.

Of the total amount, two million ADSs are being sold by EDAP and two million ADSs by certain shareholders. The selling shareholders granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to buy up to 600,000 additional ADSs.
The global offering will be made through Lehman Brothers and Oppenheimer & Co Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to fund research and development of high-intensity focused ultrasound technology products and the Prostatron, a medical device using transurethral microwave thermotherapy, the company said.
Proceedcs will also be used for marketing expenses relating to the Prostatron, capital expenditures and for general corporate purposes.
The company has applied to trade on Nasdaq under the stock symbol "EDAPY".
EDAP, based in Vaulx-en-Velin, Franch, develops, produces, markets and distributes a portfolio of minimally-invasive medical devices, primarily for the treatment of urological diseases.
